Messages.Author: Ma...@worldcom.com
Messages.Body:
Okay, here is another card that some of us are not sure of. Powerbase
Mexico city
says that a sabbat vamp can take a direct action to steal the blood from
this card.
The question that has come up is, Can a methuselah put this card out in
his/her
master phase, put the blood on it, and then in minion phase, have one of
their own
sabbat vamps take a direct action to steal it? Some of us say yes, some of
us say
no because it seems like a minion cannot take a direct action against it's
own methuselah.

Any ideas??

Matt
Thinks Calebos ROX!!!

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Ma...@worldcom.com wrote:
> Powerbase Mexico city

> it seems like a minion cannot take a direct action against it's
> own methuselah.

This is correct. Directed actions cannot target yourself or cards
you control unless indicated by card text.

The only card with such an indication is Rampage.

Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
Ma...@worldcom.com wrote:
> Any good ways that are sanctioned for a Nosferatu deck to get blood back?

These are the FAST ways to get pool with Nosferatu:

Nosferatu have a good number of relatively cheap Princes with both
superior Potence and Obfuscate. Carlotta Giovanni, who can recycle cards
in your ash heap, has superior Potence and inferior Obfuscate.

With this combination you can gain pool with the 5th tradition - minion
tap combo and / or the other traditions and / or votes (Parity Shift,
Consangineous Boon, Autarkis Percecution, Ancient Influence, Political
Stranglehold...)

If you don't want to walk the political path, use Minion Tap and Amadeo.
He hunts for an additional blood, and with a Hunting Ground, Inbase
Disco Frankfurt, Palatial Estate and Aaron's Feeding Razor he can get 5
Blood in one turn hunting.

There are a number of slower pool gain variants, but you seem to need
fast refuel.

> I was out like
> 2 turns later b/c my intercept sux rocks and my predator was playing a mean
> stealthy dominate Malk deck. Thru a mixture of cards that was highly
> improbable
> yet seems to fall that way, The Malkavian IC member Leandro bled me for like
> 8 or 9. Unfortunately, I didn't pull Archon Investigation until my next
> turn.

The best ways to deal with a Malk Predator are massive bleed bounce (not
a strength of Nosferatu) and Rush and Combat (This IS a strength of
Nosferatu!)

Leandro comes out and faces some Nosferatu attacking him with a
Trap
Song of Serenity (Superior)
Torn Signpost (Superior)
(3 turns later) Disguised Weapon : Wooden Stake

= 10 normal damage + 2 aggrevated damage (Leandro burned) and you got 0
damage and keep the stake.

Messages.Author: James B. Floate
Messages.Body:
G'day,

> >Ma...@worldcom.com wrote:
> >> Any good ways that are sanctioned for a Nosferatu deck to get blood back?

<sorry for snipping your stuff out Richard :) >

Use big guys and Minion Tap like crazy. Have Selma, Sheldon and Niklaus
5th trad. to refill, which the Nos can get away with at super stealth
levels. Niklaus is great if he is your first vamp too, 7 blood you can
siphon off. My Nos deck is animalism heavy so I dont tend to get bled a
lot. Rats, Cats, Dogs and Ravens (and groovy fluro painted sport-bikes)
makes sure I know where my predator is going to strike. As the other
guys pointed out, if you dont want your crypt skewed to those 3, you can
go the extended hunt option, again, the Nos can reasonably expect to get
their eq out because of the stealth. Also, if you mix the animalism just
right, you can generally tap your vampires out so that they can take all
the equipping actions you need. The other thing that you should consider
for a wake-and-block deck are the powerbases, which I dont normally use.
But you get 3 of them out, and protect them, and theres 3 pool a turn.
Short terms are also great because they fill in for no master card, but
you might be running out of room, and we havent even put in combat cards
yet. :) <sigh>

James B.
